description: This file contains internal functions for extended regular expression matching, including string construction, buffer management, node set operations, and DFA state management within the GNU C Library regex implementation.

methods.name: re_string_construct_common
methods.description: Initializes common fields of re_string_t structure based on input string and DFA properties.

methods.name: create_ci_newstate
methods.description: Creates a new DFA state independent of context, based on a set of nodes.

methods.name: create_cd_newstate
methods.description: Creates a new DFA state dependent on a specific context, based on a set of nodes.

methods.name: re_string_allocate
methods.description: Allocates and initializes buffers for string processing in regex matching.

methods.name: re_string_construct
methods.description: Constructs and initializes re_string_t with optional case conversion and translation.

methods.name: re_string_realloc_buffers
methods.description: Reallocates buffers within re_string_t to a new size.

methods.name: re_string_reconstruct
methods.description: Reconstructs internal buffers for a given position, handling multibyte and case conversion.

methods.name: re_string_peek_byte_case
methods.description: Peeks at the next byte in the string, considering case and multibyte characters.

methods.name: re_string_fetch_byte_case
methods.description: Fetches the next byte from the string, considering case and multibyte characters.

methods.name: re_string_destruct
methods.description: Frees resources associated with re_string_t.

methods.name: re_string_context_at
methods.description: Determines the context (word, newline, etc.) at a specific position in the input string.

methods.name: re_node_set_alloc
methods.description: Allocates memory for a node set.

methods.name: re_node_set_init_1
methods.description: Initializes a node set with a single element.

methods.name: re_node_set_init_2
methods.description: Initializes a node set with two elements.

methods.name: re_node_set_init_copy
methods.description: Copies a node set.

methods.name: re_node_set_add_intersect
methods.description: Calculates intersection of two node sets and merges into destination.

methods.name: re_node_set_init_union
methods.description: Calculates union of two node sets.

methods.name: re_node_set_merge
methods.description: Merges another node set into the destination set.

methods.name: re_node_set_insert
methods.description: Inserts an element into a node set, maintaining order.

methods.name: re_node_set_insert_last
methods.description: Inserts an element at the end of a node set.

methods.name: re_node_set_compare
methods.description: Checks if two node sets are equivalent.

methods.name: re_node_set_contains
methods.description: Checks if a node set contains a specific element.

methods.name: re_node_set_remove_at
methods.description: Removes element at specified index from a node set.

methods.name: re_dfa_add_node
methods.description: Adds a token node to DFA's node list, reallocating if necessary.

methods.name: calc_state_hash
methods.description: Calculates a hash value for a DFA state based on its node set and context.

methods.name: re_acquire_state
methods.description: Finds or creates a DFA state for a given node set.

methods.name: re_acquire_state_context
methods.description: Finds or creates a DFA state for a given node set and context.

methods.name: register_state
methods.description: Registers a new DFA state into the DFA's state table.

methods.name: free_state
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a DFA state.
